question: Can the paired-statistic crash gap in a PACE-gated self-improvement loop be removed by making one immutable logical comparison event authoritative and deriving sequential-test state from the event log rather than transactionally mutating two arms?

source_bound_observations.observation: SkillOpt has a real candidate-local PACE gate, but the inspected A/B path records feedback then mutates champion and challenger bandit arms in separate operations and mints the comparison token after remote responses.

Event ingestion accepts an Idempotency-Key; the SQL backend stores a batch in one transaction under a unique organization/idempotency-key constraint, while sequential mSPRT output is derived from event aggregates rather than advanced as a separate mutable sequential-test row.
Its current idempotency contract is too weak for semantic comparison identity: a replay with the same key but a different event body is silently deduplicated in the published SQL API test.
The middleware canonicalizes JSON bodies, hashes a request fingerprint, looks up both key and fingerprint, and returns a 422 conflict when an idempotency key is reused with a different fingerprint.

inferred_composition.status: design inference from independently observed mechanisms; not an observed end-to-end self-improvement implementation

logical_comparison_identity.semantic_fingerprint: canonical digest over the stable fields and any verdict-relevant evaluation request semantics

authoritative_evidence.record: one immutable comparison event per logical_comparison_id
authoritative_evidence.write_rule: single durable append/transaction with uniqueness on logical_comparison_id
authoritative_evidence.retry_same_id_same_fingerprint: return/replay existing outcome; do not re-apply evidence
authoritative_evidence.retry_same_id_different_fingerprint: fail closed as semantic identity conflict

sequential_state.pace_wins_losses: derive deterministically from the authoritative comparison-event log
sequential_state.e_process_or_terminal_wealth: derive/replay from the same immutable evidence frontier rather than treating mutable arm counters as authority
sequential_state.materialized_counters: optional cache only; reconstructible and integrity-checkable against the immutable log

inferred_composition.promotion_binding: promotion must pin the candidate/champion identities, comparison-log frontier or digest, PACE configuration and derived verdict used for the decision

crash_semantics: A crash after durable comparison append but before command return is replay-safe: the same ID/fingerprint resolves to the existing event.
There is no champion-only versus challenger-only authoritative update because the evidence unit contains the paired outcome atomically.
A cache/materialized-stat crash cannot alter truth if derived state is recomputed from the immutable log.
A crash before the comparison event is durable still requires a separate provider/logical-query reconciliation contract so a remotely consumed evaluation cannot be invisibly repeated.
limitations: CreativeLift's published event idempotency does not bind the key to the request body, so it cannot be copied unchanged for logical comparison identity.
idempot-js supplies request fingerprint conflict semantics but does not implement PACE, paired model evaluation, or self-improvement promotion.

No single inspected public self-improvement implementation yet combines provider-safe logical evaluation, semantic-fingerprint idempotency, immutable paired comparison events, derived PACE state, cross-candidate statistical spending, complete chronology and an adaptive-selection-unused outer test.
The statistical validity/calibration of any concrete PACE/e-process remains a separate contract from persistence/idempotency.
falsification_tests: SIGKILL after provider result reconciliation but before comparison append; resume must not consume a second logical evaluation.
SIGKILL immediately after comparison append; resume with same ID/fingerprint must not increase comparison count or PACE evidence.
Replay same logical ID with a changed candidate/champion/prompt/evaluator fingerprint; system must reject rather than silently deduplicate.
Corrupt/delete materialized arm counters then rebuild; the derived PACE verdict must equal the pre-corruption verdict from the event log.
Compare uninterrupted and kill-resume runs for identical logical comparison set, provider dispatch receipts, derived wins/losses, sequential verdict and promoted artifact identity.
exact_next_action: Search for a public self-improvement or adaptive experimentation implementation that already makes a semantically fingerprinted immutable paired comparison/event log authoritative for an anytime-valid sequential gate, preferably with provider-side stable logical query identity. If none exists, inspect whether GitMoot can be minimally converted from two authoritative arm mutations to one comparison-event append plus derived PACE state. Continue independently searching for durable cross-candidate statistical spending, bounded selection-feedback bandwidth, complete proposal chronology, immutable promotion identity, restart durability, >10 proposals and an outer test unused by adaptive selection/rollback/routing/stopping.
